title: Service setup
missing: Add {{names}} to the server environment, then restart.
ready: Text configuration is present. A successful conversation confirms connectivity.

model.noneByo: none yet; connect your own in Account → Inference
model.none: none yet; an admin sets one up

telegram.offline: not connected; check the token and server logs

voice.selfHostedDevices: self-hosted, configuration present (devices speak the replies)
voice.selfHostedNeeds: self-hosted, needs a transcription server with a realtime socket

dataKey.unsetSealed_one: not set, but {{count}} item is sealed under a data key; set it again as DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
dataKey.unsetSealed_other: not set, but {{count}} items are sealed under a data key; set it again as DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
dataKey.unset: not set; files and stored credentials use a key from SESSION_SECRET. Set DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
dataKey.unknown_one: {{count}} item is sealed under a key this server doesn’t have; set it as DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS
dataKey.unknown_other: {{count}} items are sealed under a key this server doesn’t have; set it as DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS
dataKey.resealing_one: set; re-sealing {{count}} item sealed under an older key
dataKey.resealing_other: set; re-sealing {{count}} items sealed under an older key

plugins.notYet: {{name}} is not backed up yet: its first backup comes with the next scheduled backup
plugins.undeclared: {{name}} is not backed up: the installed version declares no backup
plugins.undeclaredSince: {{name}} is not backed up: the installed version declares no backup (flagged {{since}})
plugins.disabled: {{name}} is disabled, so it isn’t backed up ({{last}})
plugins.disabledSince: {{name}} is disabled since {{since}}, so it isn’t backed up ({{last}})
plugins.allBackedUp: every plugin with its own storage is backed up

offsite.off: off; set how often in Backup schedule
offsite.failed: the last send failed{{row}}; it tries again later
offsite.failedAt: the last send failed at {{at}}{{row}}; it tries again later
offsite.failedReason: the last send failed{{row}}: {{reason}}; it tries again later
offsite.failedAtReason: the last send failed at {{at}}{{row}}: {{reason}}; it tries again later
offsite.behind: behind: the newest copy has waited {{waited}}
offsite.waiting_one: {{count}} file waiting; nothing off-site is removed until it goes
offsite.waiting_other: {{count}} files waiting; nothing off-site is removed until they go

drill.manual: only when an admin runs it
drill.passed: the last one passed at {{at}} in {{took}} ({{restores}}); rows match live
drill.passedDiffer_one: the last one passed at {{at}} in {{took}} ({{restores}}); {{count}} table differs from live by writes since the copy
drill.passedDiffer_other: the last one passed at {{at}} in {{took}} ({{restores}}); {{count}} tables differ from live by writes since the copy

keyIds.none: none; no data key is set

legacy.none: none; SESSION_SECRET is no longer needed to read stored data
legacy.items_one: {{count}} item still needs SESSION_SECRET; keep it in the recovery kit until this is zero
legacy.items_other: {{count}} items still need SESSION_SECRET; keep it in the recovery kit until this is zero
legacy.itemsBy_one: {{count}} item ({{by}}) still needs SESSION_SECRET; keep it in the recovery kit until this is zero
legacy.itemsBy_other: {{count}} items ({{by}}) still need SESSION_SECRET; keep it in the recovery kit until this is zero

reseal.finished_one: the last one finished at {{at}}: {{count}} re-sealed
reseal.finished_other: the last one finished at {{at}}: {{count}} re-sealed
reseal.unreadable_one: {{count}} under a key this server doesn’t have
reseal.unreadable_other: {{count}} under a key this server doesn’t have

keyCheck.which_neither: not a key this server uses

recovery.label: Verify a recovery key
recovery.hint: Paste the data key from escrow. It opens a sample of the latest restore and is never stored.
